map.Mean protocol: TOTAL first, then divide: Mean steps: TOTAL first. Then divide by the count. The total is not the answer. The total is the pool.
map.The mean = sum of all values ÷ how many: The mean = sum of all values ÷ how many values. It is the "fair share" of the data.
